visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot features a large black vinyl banner displaying white and orange text for '2025 台灣大力士 TAIWAN STRONGMAN SBD'. The background shows a grey sky and paved ground outdoors. (2) Inside a large indoor arena, a female athlete with long dark hair, wearing a black and orange athletic top and a lifting belt, leans against a vertical orange post. She exhales deeply, looking focused. (3) The camera shifts to a wider view of the competition floor. Several individuals in athletic wear are present. The female athlete smiles briefly while gripping the orange posts of a squat rack. (4) The female athlete performs a back squat with a heavily loaded barbell. A male judge in a white shirt watches closely while kneeling nearby. Crowds are visible in the background. (5) After completing her lift, the athlete racks the bar and celebrates with a broad smile. The camera captures her from the side and back, showing her black athletic shorts and white socks. (6) A transition shot shows a yellow banner hanging from the stands with the name 'U80 DANIEL' and humorous Chinese text. (7) A male athlete with a muscular build and short dark hair enters the arena with a confident, broad stride. He is wearing a black branded t-shirt and a lifting belt. (8) He approaches the 'Atlas Stone' event area. He begins lifting large, round concrete stones and placing them onto platforms. The camera uses a low angle to emphasize his strength and the scale of the crowd. (9) Upon finishing the event, the male athlete raises his arms in triumph, shouting towards the crowd. People in the stands are seen recording on their phones. (10) The athlete stands on a podium holding a yellow 'MONSTER Training' flag, followed by a group photo of several athletes and staff holding a celebratory banner. (11) The final scene transitions to an outdoor setting with green foliage. A cluster of large, round white mushrooms is growing at the base of some bushes on the soil.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: Two main athletes (1 female, 1 male), several judges/staff, and a large crowd in the stadium bleachers.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Character A (Xiao Ou) is a female with long black hair, wearing a black/orange athletic t-shirt and black athletic shorts. Character B (Gabi/Daniel) is a muscular male with short black hair, wearing a black branded t-shirt and black lifting belt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The primary setting is a large indoor athletic arena or stadium with tiered yellow and red seating, large LED screens, and various sponsor banners (SBD, TYR, Monster). The final clip shows a natural outdoor patch with dirt and green bushes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a male narrator's energetic voice over an upbeat, high-tempo pop-rock track. Background crowd chatter is audible. (2) A sharp transition occurs as a female voice screams 'Xiao Ou Jiayou!' with high vocal arousal. The music continues with a driving beat. (3) An English-speaking arena announcer's voice is heard over the PA system, mixed with the roar of the crowd. (4) Loud metallic clangs and percussive thuds signal gym equipment being handled. The narrator continues with high-pitched excited commentary. (5) A rhythmic chanting of '5, 4, 3, 2, 1' in Chinese rises from the crowd, followed by a huge roar of cheers. (6) A hard cut transitions to a new narrator segment. The music swells into a more epic, cinematic orchestral-rock hybrid. (7) Heavy impact sounds (thuds) occur as 'Atlas Stones' are placed on platforms. The crowd chants 'Zhang Wei-En!' repeatedly. (8) The narrator's voice becomes slightly strained with excitement during the athlete's victory. (9) The audio concludes with a calm, low-arousal male narrator's voice in a quiet outdoor setting with gentle bird chirps and wind rustling in the background.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Athlete 1 Highlights -> Athlete 2 Highlights -> Ceremony -> Epilogue
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents the creator's visit to the 2025 Taiwan Strongman competition, specifically highlighting the performances of two friends/colleagues. It aims to share the high-energy atmosphere of the event and celebrate the athletes' achievements.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Frequent prominent display of SBD, Monster Training, and Tumaz branding throughout the event highlights and group photos.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses high-energy editing and authentic crowd reactions to convey the intensity of a strongman competition. The inclusion of the mushroom clip at the end adds a personal, quirky vlog-style touch.
